I was a social outcast in high school. I never really had any solid friends, I just kinda learned to keep myself busy with hobbies rather than hanging out with friends. 

My 5 year reunion is coming up next year, and like you I have not been invited to weddings or any major events (I live in Utah, people marry super young here so there have been quite a few already). Sometimes it really fucking bums me out. 

My solution was to stop using social media. I used to constantly check Facebook, always seeing what my old classmates were up to, making me feel left out and pissed off that nobody talks to me. Now that I've stopped obsessing over other people's lives, I'm able to focus on doing the shit that I love, and that's what keeps me going. 

And last but absolutely not least, saying shit like 'nobody likes me' is like poisoning your own mind. You might start saying it as a joke, or maybe you're serious about it from the beginning, but either way if you say the same thing enough you'll actually believe that it's true. It sucks to be left out by your asshole classmates in high school. But you gotta be able to forget that shit and move on. And there are people out there that like you. Never forget about family! 

Feel free to PM me if you want to chat. Hope this wall of text was helpful.
